1. Confirm the metro station that best serves the National Air and Space Museum (I believe it is Smithsonian station).
2. Identify the metro station closest to Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF (I suspect it is the station serving Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport).
3. Identify the metro station closest to Cleveland Elementary School in Washington D.C. (or in its vicinity if multiple exist).
4. On the appropriate metro line that would serve the trip from Smithsonian to the station serving Fire Station 301 DCA ARFF without changing lines, if a traveler mistakenly goes in the opposite direction and ends up at the station identified in step 3, how many stops away is that mistaken station from the correct destination station? Provide station names and count the number of stops between them, and finally the integer difference.
Please provide detailed station listings and the final integer answer."
